## Invitations

A total of 1527 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded at 175, representing an attendance rate of 11.5 per cent. These figures provide the basis for reviewing the reach of the outreach activity and the level of participation following the invitations. The attendance result should be considered alongside the contact arrangements described below.

The figures are presented for administrative review and record the number invited and the number attending. No further interpretation is provided in this report.

## Contact

No invitations were sent by SMS. The recorded SMS contact figure was 0. No reminder messages were issued, and the recorded reminder figure was 0. The contact record therefore indicates that the invitation process did not include SMS distribution or reminder messaging.
